records.limitOrigin: research safety guard (request 180 s); the profiled request is an attribution run, not a timing run

generation.cpuApi: process.cpuUsage (user+system of the host process, worker threads included; read once at the host)

profile.clock: wall milliseconds (monotonic), read at frame boundaries and around every finder call and every applied Finding; no process CPU accounting per call

totals.note: sum = every booked cell (stage cells hold exclusive time, finder cells the finder calls); residual = root - sum (floating-point error only: no time is left unbooked)
